validation_policy.initial_state: All tasks are planned. No application validation command is bound or reported as passed by this package.
validation_policy.commands_policy: M0 binds application targets to verified executable commands after inspecting the runtime and package manager. Empty command lists are intentional. Bootstrap helpers do not prove product behavior.
validation_policy.gate_policy: Use meaningful checks for concrete invariants and risks. Do not require manual human QA, repeat implementation-shaped tests, or expand gates without a material reason.
validation_policy.evidence_policy: A done status requires observed evidence tied to the candidate commit or artifact. Record unavailable checks as limitations, never passes.

target_registry.purpose: Validate package structure, cross-references, and the initial delivery snapshot without claiming runtime behavior.
Verify the chosen runtime, package manager, OMP version, hook surface, and supported operating environment.
Check core, adapter, persisted schema, migration, and version compatibility contracts.
Check persistence, source attribution, idempotency, transactional behavior, and recovery.
Exercise actual OMP capture, scoped recall, tool outcomes, and explanations.
Exercise durable job admission, budgets, cancellation, restart, retries, and pending work.
Exercise real web journeys plus LAN startup, textual QR addresses, pairing, and private-data access.
Check resource identity, source snapshots, evidence states, lineage, history, and invalidation.
Check preference origins, independent support, correction precedence, and explanation.
Check reversible activation, separate validity and retention, and explicit forgetting.
Check dream modes, hypothesis labels, evidence fidelity, and rehearsal outcome distinctions.
Check sourced pages, manual content preservation, diffs, dependencies, and circular confirmation.
Check scoped guides, versions, evidence, reproductions, omissions, integrity, and round trips.
Check optional MCP transport, identity, policy parity, cancellation, and capability negotiation.
Check supported-platform security boundaries, reliability, privacy, performance, and restore.
Check clean installation, reproducible packaging, version metadata, and release evidence.

validation_policy.optional_work_policy: Required tasks must be done. Optional adapter tasks may be deferred only with an explicit scoped decision and must remain unavailable. A milestone may close when required and selected optional work is evidenced and all unselected optional work has a recorded disposition. Never skip native M7 archive/integrity/restore.
validation_policy.completion_policy: Task and milestone IDs remain stable. Planned evidence/evidence_required fields describe obligations; actual completion_evidence references are separate and must be nonempty before status done. Amend acceptance criteria only through an explicit recorded decision, never to disguise a failure.
